steps.label: Paket pruefen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && cat pz2_aa pz2_ab > pz2.tgz && [ "$(md5 -q pz2.tgz)" = 285ee604306a33e8b2f24983b14e0791 ] && mv pz/bundle/public pzpub && rm -rf pz && mkdir pz && tar xzf pz2.tgz -C pz && mv pzpub pz/bundle/public && ls pz/bundle/public | wc -l

steps.label: Video rendern
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && s=$(date +%s) && npx remotion render pz/bundle P pz_out2.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error && e=$(date +%s) && echo "render_seconds $((e-s))" > pz_time2.txt

steps.label: Ton und Vorschau
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i pz_out2.mp4 -i pz/mix.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest ponzi_film2.mp4 && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i ponzi_film2.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 27 -preset veryfast -vf scale=1280:-2 -c:a copy ponzi_film2_vorschau.mp4 && tar czf pz2v.tgz ponzi_film2_vorschau.mp4 && ls -la ponzi_film2*.mp4 >> pz_time2.txt
